chunks.title: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA & QLoRA) Mathematical Architecture
chunks.chunk_text: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) freezes pretrained Transformer weights W_0 in R^(d x k) and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices A in R^(r x k) and B in R^(d x r) where rank r << min(d, k). The forward pass computes h = W_0 x + (alpha / r) * B A x. Matrix A is initialized with Gaussian/Kaiming noise and Matrix B is initialized to zero so delta_W = 0 at the start of training. QLoRA combines 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization, double quantization, and paged optimizers to fine-tune LLMs on a single GPU.

chunks.title: Hybrid RAG with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) & Re-Ranking
chunks.chunk_text: Production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines dense semantic vector search in Qdrant with sparse lexical BM25 keyword retrieval. Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges rankings using the formula RRF_score(d) = sum_{m in {dense, bm25}} 1 / (k + rank_m(d)) with constant k = 60. This ensures exact technical identifiers (such as ERR_CUDA_OOM_404 or schema field names) are retrieved alongside semantically related chunks before cross-feature re-ranking and inline [DOC-ID] citation generation.

chunks.title: Statistical Data Drift Detection with Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) Test
chunks.chunk_text: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (ks_2samp) testing measures the maximum vertical distance D = sup_x |F_train(x) - F_prod(x)| between cumulative distribution functions of training and production features. When the p-value falls below significance threshold alpha = 0.05, covariate shift is flagged in drift_report.yaml and automated retraining is triggered.

chunks.title: DVC Pipeline DAGs & Reproducible Deep Learning Workflows
chunks.chunk_text: Data Version Control (DVC) defines Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) in dvc.yaml with explicit cmd, deps, params, outs, and metrics (scores.json). Running dvc repro compares current SHA256/MD5 file hashes against dvc.lock and executes only stages whose dependencies changed, pushing large binary artifacts to DagsHub remote storage via dvc push.

chunks.title: CI/CD Model Evaluation Gates & LLM Hallucination Monitoring
chunks.chunk_text: In automated LLMOps CI/CD pipelines, a new fine-tuned model is only promoted to production if its validation ROUGE-L score beats the baseline model by at least the configured gate threshold (e.g., +2.0%). Post-deployment, the LLM Monitor logs prompt/response latency, token cost, and a faithfulness grounding score measuring n-gram overlap against retrieved RAG chunks.

chunks.title: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) Subword Tokenization Algorithm
chunks.chunk_text: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) starts with a base vocabulary of 256 raw UTF-8 bytes and iteratively counts adjacent token pairs across a training corpus, merging the most frequent pair (p_1, p_2) into a new token ID >= 256. BPE eliminates out-of-vocabulary (OOV) unknown tokens while compressing frequent words and morphemes into single subword IDs.
